name: Nzambi a Mpungu (Kongo)

domain_history.domain: high-god/creator term (post-missionary Christianized usage, used to translate the Christian God from the 16th-17th century onward)
DISPUTED original precolonial meaning: personification of death (MacGaffey 2022, via early-20th-century Laman-collection texts), with the life/creation valence instead carried by bisimbi

notes: This project should NOT present "Nzambi a Mpungu, benevolent sky-father creator" as settled precolonial fact — see claim_nzambi_meaning_disputed for the two named camps.
